rationale.base_thresholds: Reuse V2 quality, decision support/margin and 20/3/65% temporal gates without label-based threshold tuning.
rationale.team_a: A full strong navy+burgundy observation must establish history. At most 10 recent weak single-color observations may use that history, only with present compatible color and no contradictory/low-quality evidence.
rationale.team_b: Lavender is mandatory; pink adds at most 25% auxiliary support and cannot assign TEAM_B alone. Shared burgundy/lavender/pink pixels are logged and not counted as independent evidence for both teams.
rationale.referee: Measure shorts at 48-72% and the unchanged V2 lower-body ROI at 60-95%. For a large person (height >=25% of image) clipped at the image bottom (last 3%), allow the V2 lower ROI to supply dark support: a clipped box shifts fixed relative body regions. The dark threshold remains V2's 10%. Socks are measured separately. Three consecutive observations, yellow, dark support, green context and no small-border ambiguity are required. This is an appearance hypothesis, not verified main-referee identity.
rationale.role_defaults: Green/edge gates are broad geometric context safeguards, not calibrated role probabilities. Ambiguous yellow staff/goalkeeper/substitute appearances remain UNKNOWN. No provided-match manual labels are consumed.
